finishStory.markedParagraph: God led the Israelites toward the Red Sea with a pillar of [CLOUD] by day and fire by night. Pharaoh changed his mind and sent an army to [CHASE] them. Trapped between the sea and the army, the frightened Israelites asked if Moses had brought them there to [DIE]. Moses told them to be still because God would [FIGHT] for them. God sent a strong wind to [SPLIT] the sea, and his people crossed on dry ground between walls of water. The Egyptians followed, but God made them [PANIC] and jammed their chariot wheels. After the Israelites reached safety, Moses held out his staff again, and God brought the waters [DOWN] on the Egyptian army.

storyOrder.text: God led Israel toward the Red Sea with a cloud by day and fire by night.

God split the sea, and the Israelites walked across on dry ground.
The Egyptians followed, but God made them panic and jammed their wheels.
God brought the water back down over the Egyptian army.
